items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: Bucket was with the other, another, a pretty small band drummer.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, he was always a rescue for me from the first time I came to New Orleans. He was like a guiding angel. And so he told me, he said, My, my boys in my band want you to play with the band. He said, and all I'll do, I'll do, I'll just, um, um, wipe the doors and attend to the business. He said, because I don't like to play much anymore. Because Joe used to like to gamble anyhow. And he before doing that, when I began to get older, then play. And he said, you can play all these special arrangements. And,…
